name: Fall Armyworm Damage
symptoms: Irregular holes and chewing damage on leaves Window-pane feeding on young leaves Large ragged holes in maize leaves Frass (insect droppings) inside leaf whorl Severely damaged or destroyed plant growing point
description: Fall armyworm is a destructive caterpillar pest that attacks maize and many other crops. Larvae feed on leaves and growing points, causing severe crop damage and yield loss.
management: Regular field scouting for early detection Hand removal of larvae in small fields Destroy heavily infested plants Use pheromone traps for monitoring
prevention: Early planting to avoid peak infestation Crop rotation Plant resistant maize varieties Maintain field sanitation
